annotations.title: Full classical remedy repertoire for a chart

description: Full remedy repertoire. Works out each graha's functional nature and afflictions, then returns beej and Vedic mantras, stotra, gemstone (for grahas to strengthen), named daana, vrata, rudraksha, yantra, conduct, the Lal Kitab remedies for its fixed house, dosha remedies and Dasha-based timing. Every family is on by default; pass false to leave one out. No topic required.

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted
